name: Digicert Mpki AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: Digicert Mpki plugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiKey
ca_plugin_config.description: Digicert mPKI REST API Key. Can also be set via DIGICERT_API_KEY environment variable.

ca_plugin_config.name: DigiCertSymUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: Base Url for Digicert mPKI REST API such as https://someurl/mpki/api/v1

ca_plugin_config.name: ClientCertLocation
ca_plugin_config.description: Path to the client certificate PFX file. Windows: C:\temp\myclientcert.pfx, Linux/Container: /secrets/client.pfx. Can alternatively set DIGICERT_CLIENT_CERT_BASE64 environment variable with base64-encoded PFX.

ca_plugin_config.name: ClientCertPassword
ca_plugin_config.description: Password for the SOAP Client Certificate. Can also be set via DIGICERT_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD environment variable.

ca_plugin_config.name: EndpointAddress
ca_plugin_config.description: Endpoint address for SOAP Service sample: https://someurl/pki-ws/certificateManagementService.

ca_plugin_config.name: TemplateDirectory
ca_plugin_config.description: Optional: Directory containing enrollment template JSON files. Supports absolute paths for container volume mounts (e.g., /templates or /app/templates). If not specified and TemplatesJson is not provided, defaults to the plugin assembly directory.

ca_plugin_config.name: TemplatesJson
ca_plugin_config.description: Optional: JSON array of enrollment templates. When provided, templates are loaded from this config instead of files. Ideal for container deployments. Format: [{"profile":{"id":"..."},"csr":"CSR|RAW",...}]. Takes precedence over TemplateDirectory.
